name: Tinned jack or horse mackerel [jurel; maasbanker]
definition: Jack or horse mackerel (Trachurus) packed in a sealed tin; Scomber mackerel is J2.4.07.
notes: José Gourmet tinned Trachurus trachurus in escabeche, 120 g; tin sold separately from Scomber

name: Tinned whelk or conch [golbaengi]
definition: Sea snails (whelk, conch) cooked and packed in a sealed tin.
notes: Dongwon 400 g canned whelk; golbaengi named on both pages (dagger confirmed); packed in soy sauce
